diagram_title: Governed hardware design workflow under IDEF0 A2A institutional regime (C03-C04)

activities.title: Capture Requirements & Expand Verified Circuit Blocks (C03-in: S0-S2)
activities.description: Systems Architect and EE Designer elicit PRD constraints, resolve parts against Component KB, and expand verified circuit blocks carrying mandatory passives and layout topology rules.

activities.title: Wire Nets & Enforce Deterministic Electrical Reconciliation (C03-gating: S3-S5)
activities.description: EE Designer wires functional pins; Verification Adversary executes check_c03 (R1-R8) with zero-silent-fallback and mints the cryptographic S5 C03 Lock Receipt.

activities.title: Engineer Physical Placement, Grid-Snap & Decoupling Topology (C04-place: P0-P3)
activities.description: Layout Specialist places footprints honoring C02 outline and keepouts; executes grid_snap and distribute_passives; Verification Adversary audits placement_preflight gate.

activities.title: Route, Tidy Silkscreen, Visual DRC Audit & Fab Release (C04-closeout: P4-P7)
activities.description: Layout Specialist routes nets and pours planes; silk_tidy clears pad overlaps; Verification Adversary audits layout_drc_gate with visual DRC crops; Release Engineer signs off fab package.

activities.title: Adjudicate Exceptions & Route Directed Repairs (Blocker Hub)
activities.description: Orchestrator logs typed blocker records (BLK-nnn.json), enforces the no-bypass rule, and routes directed repairs back to the owning A2A activity.
